instruction: Set the background color of all slides to magenta using the Master View settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires applying a magenta background (RGB [255, 0, 255]) to all slides using Master View settings. The evaluator uses the existing evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance metric to calculate color distance from the target magenta. Original background is white [255, 255, 255]. Verified that the metric returns a score based on RGB distance normalized by maximum possible distance.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all slides for background color change to magenta RGB [255, 0, 255]
Function evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance iterates through all slides and calculates RGB distance from target color
Correctly handles master-based fills (type 5) by reading from slide.slide_layout.slide_master.background.fill, which aligns with instruction requirement to edit Master View settings
Returns normalized similarity score (1 - average_distance) where perfect match yields ~1.0
Postconfig appropriately saves file with Ctrl+S before evaluation to ensure changes are persisted
Expected RGB values are semantically correct: target magenta [255, 0, 255] and original white [255, 255, 255]
Edge case handling: if slides retain original color, distance=1 (penalized); if changed to magenta, distance~0 (rewarded)
